messages:
devon: heads up — after last ATS bridge deploy i'm seeing candidate records without scorecard links. example: candidate 2024-563 shows 'scorecard_url': null. Anyone else?
jon: saw one earlier, thought it was transient. which job? any logs?
devon: eng-swe req-314. here's webhook payload we got:
```
{ "candidate_id": 2024563, "scorecard_url": null }
```
maria (Talent Ops): ugh — that breaks our interviewer flows. I had 3 folks blocked today. opened ticket #RECRUIT-219.
recruiting-bot: Ticket created: RECRUIT-219 by maria — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RECRUIT-219
elaine (People Ops): workaround for now: recruiters can attach scorecards manually in Greenhouse via Candidate > Add form. Not ideal.
devon: can we re-send the webhook? maybe the enrichment service failed. @jon can you requeue payloads from kafka?
jon: yep, will requeue a batch now. i'll ping when done. putting eng-oncall on the thread: @ops-oncall
ops-oncall: requeue succeeded for 120/125 messages, 5 still failing — investigating auth errors.
jon: logs show 401s from enrichment-service -> ats-proxy. putting a rollback on the last deploy while we triage :warning:
maria (Talent Ops): also heads up — with scorecards missing we should postpone interviewer training scheduled tomorrow. will look for a new date.
devon: thanks. i'll add a quick check to the recruiter checklist: verify scorecard link present before inviting.
elaine (People Ops): can we add an automated alert on missing scorecard field in the pipeline? that would catch this earlier.
jon: yes, i'll add a datadog metric for scorecard_url==null and trigger a PagerDuty. prepping PR now.
recruiting-bot: incident note added to RECRUIT-219 by jon.
devon: once this is fixed we should spin up a 15-min interviewer training refresh — many folks had trouble due to the blank links.
maria (Talent Ops): agree. i'll coordinate new time and send updated calendar invites after we get greenlight.
jon: rollback complete, reprocessed remaining 5, all good now. closing loop.
devon: confirmed — scorecards reappeared for the stuck candidates. thanks all :thumbsup:
maria (Talent Ops): will keep training tentative until EOD. thanks team.
